integrity: Analytical proof establishes the all-order statement. Exact rational calculations corroborate finite cases but are not treated as proof of infinitely many orders. External independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Real degree-two spherical harmonics on the normalized two-sphere; integer even exponents only. No claims for general real p, complex harmonics, or other harmonic degrees. Equivalent unindexed historical results are possible.
title: Exact even-moment norms for real quadratic harmonics on the two-sphere
